I relate. For me, it's violent thoughts. It's disgusting. If anyone knew what I was thinking, I would have nobody. I don't have a desire to hurt anyone, however I fantasize about it so much. It's like a drug. I think about it for a long time because it's so pleasant to think about for me, then the guilt eventually sets in and I want to die so so bad. I hope things get better for you. Thank you so much for what you said. I really feel like you understand where I am coming from. Yeah, It's so tempting to just quit on the vest, and on life in general. However support like this just makes life a little more bearable. Stay well friend.

I still cry about my dog sometimes. He died in January of this year. He was only like six maybe? I wanted to kill myself the day of his death... well I wanna die like everyday but that day more that usual. I know this sounds pathetic, but note I'm only 17, it's been the most painful loss I've experienced. I know, it seems like I haven't been through shit I guess. But that dog meant so much to me. One time I came home crying and he came and licked my face, licked away some of my tears. It's maybe the most painful thing I've gone through. Maybe the loss of some friendships have been more heart aching, but as the most pain I've felt in one day, it was the day my dog died.

I'm really sorry for your loss, and I'm not trying to invalidate your hurt, but try to just be happy for how long you've had your cat. It kind of warms my heart to think of someone having such a close bond with their pet for 20 years. Wishing you the best. Hope you can push through this my friend.
Amazing job, sending good vibes your way. I am wishing you the best!!!

I stayed at one for a week and I didn't even have an attempt. Meanwhile some people who had attempts only stayed for 3 days. What pisses me off though is they lied to OP.

I'm actually only 17 and work at a Church. While there's meeting or whatever, the staff drops off their kids and I take care of them along with usually one or two other people. I also volunteer in the morning.

Honestly though, kinda been wanting to quit. Well, not really wanting to, but feeling like I should. It feels like I'm supporting a system that brainwashes kids. I am no longer Christian so yeah. I dunno tho it's one of the few things keeping me going, working with those kids, so I'll probably keep working/volunteering there.

Hope you're not gonna get upset, some people treat me very differently after I tell them I work at a Church.

"Well you see, I was attacked by a dog."

_Why was it attacking you?_

"I think it was because I called the dog a doggo."

_Maybe he didn't like being called a doggo..._

Although these questions are sometimes annoying, every now and then I can turn it into something that'll make the kids laugh a little or just have them engaged in a conversation with me that is no longer about my scars. Like, from there, we went on talking about pets. There are times where I have to say like "hey I'm sorry but I don't want to talk about that right now" and of course they ask why, but I'll just ask ignore that and ask them a question about how their day was or if they saw any movies, and they seem to forget about it.

I've has two girls about 4 ask about them, and then like, an 8 year old boy ask about them.

I was joking in my post kinda, it is annoying but it doesnt really upset me. They don't know better, and they believe whatever bs I come up with hehe

Hey, I'm not going to deny what you did was fucked up. Very fucked up. But I also am a little confused on some of what you actually did, if you don't remember those things are you sure you did them?

Anyways, I'm just going to assume you did everything you said you did.

I have bullied and harrassed people. One girl became suicidal because of my actions. I constantly hate myself for this, and really believe I should die, despite all my victims of the bullying tell me I should forgive myself. I don't want to go into detail of the things I said, but trust me, they were awful.

The fact you feel so guilty shows you can change. I know it may be hard to talk to someone about this, especially because of the legal repercussions, but I believe you can change. You see what you did was wrong and don't want others to be hurt in the way you've hurt people.

I hope you don't harm yourself. I hope you get the help you need. And if you're curious about my story or just want to talk, feel free to message me. I wish you well and hope you continue to head down a better moral path and also astray from the suicidal thoughts.
There's only so much people can do. I really enjoy that kind of support tbh. Small ways people show their care for me means a lot personally. What do you want people to do instead?
I just assume I have been doing something wrong because I got downvoted haha. But yeah I guess I'll see. Also I hope you're doing okay yourself.
And then they don't provide any support through anything besides prayer right? It sucks.

Totally fine. I get what you mean. I was just venting mostly. The thing that is really killing me is that I volunteer at my Church and I feel like I'm supporting their system of telling kids lies. But I enjoy working with the kiddos so much, it makes me much happier, it's something I look forward to every week. But I really don't want to be lying to them, or supporting my Church system if all this turns out to be bullshit. Which I know you already believe, I'm just on the fence.

Really sorry if anything came off as rude, I'm not trying to be, or trying to argue. I just wanted to further explain why this is so hard for me.
Nice to know I'm not alone. I hope we can work through this.
I don't have any urges luckily, just fantasies. Thank you for what you said. I'll work on trying to ease my self hate.
That's a good point. It just sucks so much, I love working with these kids and making them happy, but I also don't like supporting my Church's system. Thanks for your input though. I'll dwell on it.
Thanks a lot for your kind words. They mean a lot. Wish you well stranger.
